verdict.rationale: doola sells a Registered Agent service with online signup at $297/year, and it is included with every formation in all 50 states. The evidence never shows the exact agent name and street address being given to the founder for a filing, let alone on the same day. The only 'same day' claim covers mail scans, which is a different capability, and nothing covers standalone purchase for a change-of-agent filing. Missing for 10: documented delivery of the exact RA name/street address, same-day turnaround for that information, support for change-of-agent filings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can buy registered-agent service online and get the exact agent name and street address my formation or change filing needs the same day
